owner_decisions_2026_11_07.jev_question_formats: Resolved: support all TypeSafe Jev API question formats (the API is the source of truth): keyed questions object with choice/score/noul types and criteria maps, state string|object|array; flat body {model, state, questions}; schemas in sc-decision-schema. r-5 unblocked.
owner_decisions_2026_11_07.sc_sha_raw_bytes: Resolved from the sc-sha 1.7.0 source: calculate_hash takes strict UTF-8 text and normalizes CRLF/CR to LF; there is no raw-bytes API. serde_json compact bodies contain no raw CR, so the digest equals SHA-256 of the sent bytes. Non-UTF-8 bodies are impossible. sc-sha depends on sha2 (transitive only).
